info.name: User and Access Management Organization Roles API
Returns the list of organization roles.

params.name: sort
params.description: Used for sorting the list. Ascending by default. Prepend a hyphen, "-", to get a descending sort, for example "-name". The default is name. Allowed: name.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results returned. The value must be within 1 - 100 (both inclusive). The default value is 100.

params.name: offset
params.description: Starting point or position of the first result returned. The default value is 0.

items.docs:
Returns a list of organization roles. Use query parameters to filter the result based on different criteria.

API client must have at least one permission.

Creates an organization role.

API Client needs the **User management > Manage organization roles** permission.

info.name: Returns a list of users with a specific organization role.

params.name: nameOrEmailContains
params.description:
Filters list by name or email. Parameter value must be URL-encoded (percent-encoding) to ensure it's correctly interpreted by the server. Example: Searching for an email with a +
            
 Incorrect: .../users?email=`john+doe@example.com`.
            
 Correct: .../users?email=`john%2Bdoe@example.com`

params.name: nameOrEmailOrUsernameContains
params.description:
Filters list by name, email, or username. Parameter value must be URL-encoded (percent-encoding) to ensure it's correctly interpreted by the server. Example: Searching for an email with a +
            
 Incorrect: .../users?email=`john+doe@example.com`.
            
 Correct: .../users?email=`john%2Bdoe@example.com`

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results returned. The value must be within 1 - 100 (both inclusive). The default value is 100.

params.name: offset
params.description: Starting point or position of the first result returned. The default value is 0.

params.name: sort
params.description: Used for sorting the list. Ascending by default. Prepend a hyphen, "-", to get a descending sort, for example "-name". The default is name. Allowed: userKey, name, email, status, lastLoginAt.

params.name: embed
params.description: List of fields to embed in the response.
